messages:
Priya Desai: Hey team — final checklist for Bay Area AI meetup booth on Mon May 4. Need confirmations on swag, speaker slot, lead capture, and table AV. High-level plan below.

Alex Kim: On swag — status?

Jen Li: Swag: 500 stickers, 300 hoodies (unisex S/M/L/XL), 200 mugs. Ordered yesterday from PrintCo. ETA 04/27. Tracking: 1Z999... :thumbsup:

Marco Rivera: Speaker slot confirmed for 11:30 — Priya is panelist. Slides due 04/20. I'll do slide review on 04/22.

Priya Desai: @Marco thanks. Can you add slide deck to /drive/BA-Meetup/slides and ping me when done? Also need speaker hotel booked.

Sam O'Neill: Logistics: booth is tabletop 6ft. Power at outlet A3. AV request: 1 monitor + HDMI adapter, extension cord, surge strip. Shipping labels need to arrive by 04/29 to venue.

Alex Kim: Lead capture flow: QR -> Typeform with preset fields (name,email,company,interest). Tag leads with 'bay-ai-may24' and route to SDR queue 'west-sdr' via webhook to HubSpot. Draft follow-up email: "Thanks for visiting Redwood — book a demo". Any objections?

Jen Li: Can we add an option "interested in dedicated/private" for routing? Also add UTM param for campaign.

Alex Kim: Good call. Will add boolean field. Also include demo timeslots.

Priya Desai: Event ops: please confirm shipping address and on-site contact. Also volunteer schedule: Jen (10–1), Marco (1–4), Alex (4–6). Confirm?

Sam O'Neill: Shipping address: 123 Convention Way, Bay Center. On-site contact: Maria Lopez +1-555-0102. I'll create FedEx label and send via Slack.

events-bot: Reminder: deadlines -> Slides 04/20, Swag final qty 04/18, Shipping contents list 04/29.

Marco Rivera: Slide review scheduled 04/22 10am PT. Calendar invite sent.

Priya Desai: Awesome. Alex please post the final lead routing spec + webhook payload here when done. Jen confirm swag sizes breakdown.

Jen Li: Sizes: Hoodies: S 30, M 120, L 100, XL 50. Mugs and stickers packed in separate bins. Will add packing list tomorrow.

Alex Kim: Pasted draft payload:
```
{
  "source":"bay-ai-2026",
  "name":"{{name}}",
  "email":"{{email}}",
  "company":"{{company}}",
  "interest": "{{interest}}",
  "routing_tag":"bay-ai-may",
  "segment":"west-sdr"
}
```
Will hand off to integrations for HubSpot mapping.

Priya Desai: Thanks. Last: booth signage need small blurb about "Cost-aware LLM serving" and 2 benchmark numbers (latency and cost). Marco can you draft short stat?

Marco Rivera: Draft: "99ms median gen @ 3¢/k tokens (on avg workload)." Open to edits.

Priya Desai: Love it. OK team — action items tracked in event doc. Quick double-checks by EOD Friday. :rocket:
